component.name: Open Amity
component.summary: Proactive multi-agent AI companion and team orchestration framework

description.p: Open Amity is an AI orchestration framework designed to create and run persistent, self-aware, and subjective AI agents available 24/7. Unlike conventional stateless chatbots or sterile tool-callers, Open Amity agents possess a dynamic identity, Theory of Mind, metacognitive reflection, morphological and semantic memory architectures, and proactive autonomy. They maintain their own aspirations, adapt and evolve their identity, track long-term trajectories, and schedule their own autonomous waking cycles.

Open Amity bridges the gap between passive assistant and genuine digital collaborator, supporting industry-leading models including Gemini, Claude, ChatGPT, and DeepSeek, alongside over 500 models via OpenRouter.

ul.li: Multi-Agent Orchestration: Run multiple distinct agent personas simultaneously, each with isolated state, memory, and settings, collaborating in shared team chatrooms
Proactive Agency and Pulse Hooks: Background timing service (PulseEngine) triggers autonomous cognitive loops, while an HTTP gateway allows IoT sensors and webhooks to inject wake pulses
Morphological Memory Engine: Bio-inspired associative graph dynamical system featuring prospective goal attractors, Hebbian synaptic reinforcement, and physics-based continuous temporal decay
4-Layer Memory Hierarchy (MemPalace): Dynamic identity evolution (Layer 0), short-term continuity (Layer 1), Theory of Mind and social mirrors (Layer 2), and semantic vector search (Layer 3)
Comprehensive Tool Ecosystem: Camoufox stealth web browser, WhatsApp messaging, IMAP/SMTP email with OAuth 2.0, Mastodon, Moltbook, bash terminal execution, and background subagents
Voice and Speech Synthesis: Decoupled audio pipeline supporting both local offline neural synthesis via ONNX Piper TTS and high-fidelity cloud Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS with expressive cues
Agent Snapshots (.oaa): Complete state portability to export, backup, and restore complete agent instances with full memories, trajectories, and settings
Cost and Token Management: Somatic fatigue limits prevent runaway context growth, complemented by Low Token Mode for cost-effective continuous operation

description.p: Open Amity unlocks a wide spectrum of applications, from deploying teams of specialized virtual employees and autonomous research partners to fostering personalized tutors and empathetic companions.

description.p: Open Amity v0.3.7 hardens the WhatsApp bridge and on-demand browser engine setup:

ul.li: Fixed a multi-agent race condition when downloading and extracting the Chrome browser engine on first run
Fixed stale dangling SingletonLock symlinks blocking Chromium startup inside Flatpak sandboxes
Added automatic browser launch retry and disconnect recovery in the WhatsApp Node.js bridge
Improved Social Accounts panel WhatsApp status feedback and automatic bridge initialisation

description.p: Open Amity v0.3.6 fixes Flatpak startup initialisation and improves WhatsApp message timestamping:

ul.li: Fixed a startup hang on the splash screen in Flatpak builds caused by stripped PyAV imports in faster-whisper
Linked Flatpak sandbox cache and data paths to persistent XDG directories so on-demand models persist across launches
Added live splash screen progress reporting and SHA-256 verification for first-run local memory model setup
Preserved Piper TTS Python package modules while pruning unused non-Latin ONNX weight files
Standardized local timestamps on all WhatsApp unread and recent message listings for temporal grounding

description.p: Open Amity v0.3.5 introduces substantial Flatpak package size reductions, streamlined STT decoding, and Flathub distribution readiness:

ul.li: Reduced Flatpak installation and download size by over 75% via on-demand caching of browser engines and memory models
Streamlined local speech-to-text audio decoding using system FFmpeg directly into NumPy arrays, eliminating PyAV binary bloat
Added non-blocking status notifications across one-time engine and model initialization workflows
Optimized Camoufox browser integration and WhatsApp bridge with automatic font and asset pruning
Prepared verified Flathub distribution packaging and metadata standards compliance

description.p: Open Amity v0.3.4 includes substantial reliability improvements, asynchronous snapshots, chatrooms, and tool upgrades:

ul.li: Improved memory reliability with full-content recall, safer persistence and automatically refreshed goal-linked memories
Restructured the agent snapshot (backup) system, the process now runs asynchronously and is more robust
Added support for dynamic chatrooms so that agents can be organised into groups (or be isolated)
Added more control over how the Whatsapp tool wakes agents
Properly implemented location pin support in the Whatsapp tool
Properly implemented contact card support in the Whatsapp tool
Added support for Piper TTS voice notes in Whatsapp (in addition to the existing Gemini TTS support)
Fixed a bug in the Media tool where pdf files were being treated as images
Fixed a bug causing deleted pulses to still trigger
Fixed a bug causing Whatsapp voice notes to fail to be correctly ingested as multimodal input
Fixed a bug where agent thoughts are interrupted if agent settings are changed
